text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a second! Why're you trying to
scout someone who just lost
big-time?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try scouting Kitasan Black right after her
loss in the scrimmage.
Rather than
excitement, she responds with
bewilderment.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I did lose and all, so what about
me got you interested?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You picked me for my looks? Um,
I'm happy you were watching
me that
closely, but I was sort of hoping you liked
my running...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, I don't even have the right to be
scouted yet. I'm just a
newbie...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you're a trainer, so that means
you're a specialist, right?
Could I ask you
some stuff about my running? Please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame about my scouting offer, but I
agree to hear her out some
other time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The appointed time comes and goes, but
Kitasan Black is nowhere in
sight. She
didn't seem like the type to break a
promise...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Mr. Sumo Wrestler, did you twist
your ankle? I guess lending
you my
shoulder won't help much, will it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Here, I'll carry you. Don't be
shy—I've got good shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Your puppy ran away?! Wait, is it
that German shepherd over
there? All
righty, here I go...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! Your truck won't move?! And
inside... you've got relief
supplies?! Then
we have to hurry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How about this—I'll carry the supplies!
Don't worry, it's only twenty
kilometers
round trip! Piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry... It's already this late, too...
Whenever I see someone in
need, I just
can't stop myself from helping them out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, I gave a sumo wrestler a piggyback ride, caught a puppy, and carried some relief supplies. None of them took too long, but all together... I'm so, so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems like Kitasan Black isn't just
well-mannered, but an altruist, to
boot. I
decide to let her tardiness slide and hear
her out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So how can I run better during races? The
races here at Tracen are
different from
what I'm used to, and I feel like I'm
completely out of
my element.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I know I have to change something, but I don't know where to start, or what I should even work on...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My strengths! Right... Hmm, I've always
acted based on my instincts,
so I've never
thought about that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hm, which means... I need to learn more
about myself. And to do that,
I need—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Strong rivals! Got it! In short... I have to
race against lots of tough
opponents!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I organize a scrimmage for Kitasan Black,
inviting only the cream of
the crop.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita! Today, I'm racing you.. and another,
right? You know—the
legend herself!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... If I want to figure out what my
strengths are, then I've got to
race against
the best of the best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for the wait, Kita. I was
informed that you wish to learn
what your
own merits are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A fine motive—I will lend you my
assistance. We have a 3,000-meter
run
ahead of us, so please show me all the
abilities in your arsenal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kitasan Black's scrimmage with
Tracen Academy's top
stayer—Mejiro
McQueen—kicks off.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Huh?! She's getting farther away? And I
can't... catch up?! Nnngh!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now! Kita—you're on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Dia?! Was she just biding her time in the
back?! No way!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I don't want to lose, not again! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Kitasan Black finishes in third
place.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm pathetic. I lost to McQueen in
stamina, and Dia in terms of
strategy...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, I haven't figured out anything!
If this keeps up, how will I
ever inspire
others through my racing?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Running like this won't encourage anyone.
I'll never be like my dad at
this rate...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My dad is an enka singer. He's got
fans and pupils that really
respect him...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dad's popular for a reason. He knows
when others are going through
rough
times, and he's never afraid to extend a
helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Singing and racing are different, but I still
want to be like him. I want
to be someone
who can inspire others and brighten up
their day...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But if I can't even figure out my own
strengths, then there's no way
that'll ever
happen. All I'm good for... is helping
others with small
chores.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But anyone can do stuff like that, right?
Basically, I'm just a bit of a
busybody.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My heart aches seeing Kitasan Black get so
down on herself. Sure, her
shortcomings
might've been exposed in today's race,
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How about this—I'll carry the supplies!
Don't worry, it's only twenty
kilometers
roundtrip! Piece of cake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was late to our meeting because she
helped a few people out
along the way. To
her, it wasn't anything special...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But those small chores might conceal the
hint she's looking for.
Following this train
of thought, I decide to tackle the problem
with a
new approach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hm, this is quite troubling... Either I wait
for warmer weather, or...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, what's on your mind? Ah, I
know—didn't you race Kita the
other day?
Is it about that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That case has already been settled.
Currently, I'm worried about our

mountaintop villa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It appears that the generator there is
malfunctioning. Were it not for
the snow, I
could have carried over a new one as part
of my training...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're... that trainer from last time.
What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Sorry?! You want Kitasan Black to do it?
But what for?
